stations.title: Fill 0.5 L
stations.does: Fills each bottle with still mineral water to the target fill volume and indexes it forward.

stations.title: Screw cap
stations.does: Screws a blue cap onto each filled bottle and indexes it forward.

stations.title: Apply wrap label
stations.does: Applies the wrap-around label to each capped bottle and indexes it forward.

stations.title: Camera inspect & reject
stations.does: Inspects each bottle for fill level and cap presence/condition; rejects failing bottles by pushing them off the line while good bottles continue.

notes: Takt is 5.0 s/unit (720 units/h). Station budgets must not exceed takt; the slowest station sets line rate. Station ST4 (inspection/divert) is kept at the full 5.0 s budget; if your camera/IO cycle time is faster, you can reduce ST4’s seconds and potentially enable margin elsewhere.

Exact target fill volume/headspace, label application method (wet/dry, heat required or not), and cap torque/engagement criteria were not provided; builder should parameterize these based on the actual product specification.
